vm_constraints.clone_pattern: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj)) or shallow spread for known shapes

strict_marker_sot.location: Duplicated as const STRICT_MARKER_SOT in: Final Surface Strict Scan, Final Surface Strict Re-Scan, Build Strict Surface Repair Payload (for LLM context), optional inline in Build Final Public Payload for custom merge only

families.label: human label
families.replacement_guidance: neutral factual wording; no new claims

families.label: аккуратн*
families.replacement_guidance: Remove or replace with neutral process description

families.label: удобств*
families.replacement_guidance: Use structural/factual phrasing without convenience claims

families.label: контрол*
families.replacement_guidance: Use check/verify nouns sparingly; prefer factual steps

families.label: безопасн*
families.replacement_guidance: Avoid safety superlatives; cite verifiable checks if needed

families.label: наглядн*
families.replacement_guidance: Replace perception/clarity marketing with structural description
families.note: Added from smoke 3352 synonym escape after Strict Cleanup remap

custom_task_markers.scope: per-task only; merged at scan time
custom_task_markers.source: Route Command NL parse OR Build Final Public Payload brief parse
custom_task_markers.must_not: Permanently append to central SOT file/object in repo without operator charter

strict_marker_sot.detection_helper_pseudocode: for each family: new RegExp(family.stem, family.flags); test each string leaf in surface walk

meta.effective_strict_surface_gate: boolean — true when NL trigger OR always true for hard SOT enforcement
meta.memory_status: approved_clean | repair_attempted_clean | blocked_dirty | failed (set before memory append)

source_fields: outline render — sections, tables.decision_reason, faq list

seo_strategy_public.content: bullets: primary keyword, h1, section intents, table titles only

seo_qa_public.summary: string | null — candidate; include_summary flag set true only if scan clean

tables_summary.source: allowlisted table explanation lines from text/tz

telegram.parts_preview: array of { part_index, text } — full composed candidate

residuals.surface: seo_tz | seo_strategy_public | seo_text | seo_qa_public | factcheck_public | tables_summary | telegram_preview

strict_surface_scan_result.blocked: boolean — true when verdict dirty and used for gate

protected_fields: headings h1-h3 text (may rephrase banned words only)
table row keys and column headers

repaired_surfaces.description: object with same keys as public_payload.surfaces; only changed fields populated

unchanged_protected_fields: array of field paths left untouched
errors: array of strings when status error

fields.sanitized_payload: JSON string of public_payload when approved; empty when blocked
fields.blocked_diagnostic: JSON string when blocked_dirty; null otherwise
fields.raw_internal_ref: JSON string or compressed ref to internal.* for debug

rules: blocked_dirty must not populate sanitized_payload with full polluted composite
approved_clean requires strict_surface_scan.verdict clean and repair_attempts=0
repair_attempted_clean requires repair_attempts>=1 and rescan clean

blocked_dirty.body: blocked_diagnostic only: banner, task_id, residuals summary

get_contract.admin_raw_future: optional; out of sandbox v1 scope

format_run_pipeline_input_expectation.when_public_payload_present: Render exclusively from public_payload; ignore raw seo_strategy for Telegram

blocked_diagnostic.banner: STRICT QA REJECT — output blocked before final send
blocked_diagnostic.residuals_summary: array max 5 of { surface, family, field_path, snippet }
